name: Add React Dashboard Page
description: Creates a new page component for the Metabob Cloud Dashboard, adds routing to App.tsx, and updates sidebar navigation. Follows React 19, shadcn/ui, and Bun patterns.

variables.name: pageName
variables.description: Name of the page to create (e.g., 'Members', 'UsageAnalytics', 'ExecutionTraces')

variables.name: pageDescription
variables.description: Brief description of what the page displays or does

variables.name: iconName
variables.description: Icon emoji or text to use in sidebar (e.g., '👥', '📊', '📋')

tasks.description: Analyze existing dashboard pages and component patterns

prompt.template:
Analyze the Metabob Cloud Dashboard structure to understand existing patterns:

1. **Read existing pages** in repos/metabob-cloud-dashboard/src/pages/:
   - Look at APIKeys.tsx or Settings.tsx for page structure patterns
   - Note how they import components from @/components/ui
   - Observe state management patterns (useState, hooks)
   - Check how they use shadcn components (Card, Button, etc.)

2. **Review App.tsx** at repos/metabob-cloud-dashboard/src/App.tsx:
   - Find the Page type definition (union of page IDs)
   - Locate the renderPage() function and switch statement
   - Note the import patterns at the top

3. **Review Sidebar.tsx** at repos/metabob-cloud-dashboard/src/components/Sidebar.tsx:
   - Find the navItems array
   - Note the structure: { id, label, icon }
   - Observe how icons are defined (text/emoji format)

4. **Check dependencies** in repos/metabob-cloud-dashboard/package.json:
   - Verify React version (should be 19.x)
   - Check for shadcn/ui components
   - Note if Tailwind CSS is configured

Summarize the patterns you find - these will guide creating the new page.

tasks.description: Create the new page component file

prompt.template:
Create the {{pageName}} page component. **File**: repos/metabob-cloud-dashboard/src/pages/{{pageName}}.tsx **Requirements**: 1. Use functional component with TypeScript 2. Import from '@/components/ui' for shadcn components (Card, CardHeader, CardTitle, etc.) 3. Import cn from '@/lib/utils' for className utilities 4. Follow the pattern from existing pages (APIKeys.tsx, Settings.tsx) 5. Include a placeholder layout with: - Page title using CardHeader/CardTitle - Brief description: {{pageDescription}} - Placeholder content area (e.g., "Content coming soon") 6. Export the component as named export: export function {{pageName}}() **Example structure**: ```tsx import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card"; export function {{pageName}}() { return (
{{pageName | titleCase}} {{pageDescription}} {/* Page content */}
Page content will be implemented here.
); } ``` Follow existing code style exactly (2-space indentation, functional components, TypeScript types).

tasks.description: Add the new page to App.tsx routing

prompt.template:
Add {{pageName}} page to the routing in App.tsx.

**File**: repos/metabob-cloud-dashboard/src/App.tsx

**Changes needed**:

1. **Add import** at the top (after existing page imports):
   ```tsx
   import { {{pageName}} } from "@/pages/{{pageName}}";
   ```

2. **Update Page type** (around line 23):
   Add "{{pageId}}" to the union type:
   ```tsx
   type Page = "api-keys" | "settings" | "{{pageId}}" | "signup" | "login";
   ```

3. **Add case to renderPage()** function (inside Dashboard component):
   Add a new case in the switch statement:
   ```tsx
   case "{{pageId}}":
     return <{{pageName}} />;
   ```

Use the Edit tool to make these changes. Follow the exact formatting of existing imports and cases.

Add {{pageName}} to the sidebar navigation.

**File**: repos/metabob-cloud-dashboard/src/components/Sidebar.tsx

**Changes needed**:

1. **Add to navItems array** (around line 9-12):
   Add a new item to the navItems array:
   ```tsx
   { id: "{{pageId}}", label: "{{pageName | titleCase}}", icon: "{{iconName}}" },
   ```

**Note**: The icon should be an emoji or text character. If {{iconName}} is not provided, use a default like "📄".

Place this item in a logical position (usually before "settings" which is typically last).

Use the Edit tool to make this change. Maintain the existing array format and indentation.

tasks.description: Verify TypeScript compilation and page accessibility

prompt.template:
Verify the {{pageName}} page is properly integrated.

**Steps**:

1. **Type check** the dashboard:
   ```bash
   cd repos/metabob-cloud-dashboard
   bun run typecheck
   ```
   Fix any TypeScript errors.

2. **Check imports** are correct:
   - Verify {{pageName}}.tsx has no import errors
   - Verify App.tsx imports {{pageName}} correctly
   - Ensure all @/components/ui imports are valid

3. **Verify routing**:
   - Confirm Page type includes "{{pageId}}"
   - Confirm renderPage() has case for "{{pageId}}"
   - Confirm navItems includes the new navigation item

4. **Build check** (optional but recommended):
   ```bash
   cd repos/metabob-cloud-dashboard
   bun run build
   ```

If there are errors, fix them before completing.
